title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan says 'do nothing' about distillation as AI giants accuse China of copying their tech
summary_full: At Y Combinator’s annual Demo Day, CEO Garry Tan explained why he's less concerned about frontier AI model distillation and the existential risk of AI.
